name: The Factory 10
old_description: Express yourself and show the world who you are with The Factory 10 by MaliaMonique custom apparel. At F10 we fulfill all your custom apparel needs from face masks, custom tees, bags, hats, dresses, etc.
about:
The Factory 10 operates from Columbia, South Carolina, as a family-owned and operated business known as The Factory 10 by MaliaMonique. The owner, Tonia, runs the company with her daughter Kyndall, focusing on custom apparel that allows individuals to express their personality through clothing.

The company produces a range of custom apparel including face masks, t-shirts, bags, hats, dresses, and cups. Its core service is custom design and printing, with a process that includes mocking up designs for customer approval before production. The business serves both retail customers and wholesale clients, though facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

Customers span individual consumers of all ages — wearing items at home, the gym, school, workplaces, and college campuses — as well as businesses and nonprofits seeking merchandise. One cited client, PGD Innovations, a nonprofit, relies on The Factory 10 for all its merchandise, including pricing, fabric selection, and design guidance.

The company states its mission rests on three pillars: empowerment, sustainability, and social impact. It emphasizes inclusive designs, eco-friendly practices, and collaborations with local artisans and marginalized communities. A portion of profits supports charitable organizations, and the company guarantees certified quality products with immediate replacement if unsatisfied.
